title: Pre-verdict calibration_entry record
description: One line of run_state/events.jsonl: the /todo cockpit's PRE-VERDICT calibration capture (ARCH §6.5.4). The human types a free-text prediction + a confidence scalar in [0,1] BEFORE the verdict form unlocks, against a surfaced finding (ref_id). Discriminated on event_type='calibration_entry' AND phase='pre_verdict'. This is a DISTINCT shape from the post-experiment calibration_entry member in schema/events.jsonl.schema.json (which is keyed on experiment_id/metric_name/range). The two collide on event_type 'calibration_entry'; the 'phase' const disambiguates them so both coexist in one events.jsonl. RECONCILED (D-055): schema/events.jsonl.schema.json carries an additive 'pre_verdict' oneOf branch matching this shape, so a pre-verdict row validates against both this focused schema (which the writer self-validates against) and the events.jsonl spine schema.

event_type.description: Discriminator. Must be the literal 'calibration_entry' (matches ARCH §6.5.4 + the events.jsonl.schema.json discriminator literal so a reader still discriminates on event_type).

phase.description: Secondary discriminator. The literal 'pre_verdict' tells a single events.jsonl consumer this is the cockpit's pre-verdict finding capture, NOT the post-experiment metric calibration_entry, without re-deriving from field presence.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 / RFC 3339, UTC, when the calibration was recorded (BEFORE the verdict unlocked).

ref_id.description: The surfaced finding / loop_memory id this prediction is about (the cockpit's --ref-id). Named ref_id (not experiment_id) because this is a finding-level pre-verdict capture.

prediction.description: Free-text human prediction typed BEFORE the verdict unlocks (the cockpit's --prediction).

confidence.description: Confidence scalar in the closed interval [0,1] (the cockpit's --confidence). A JSON number, never a string. Out-of-range is REJECTED, never clamped (inviolate rule 4).

by.description: Who recorded it (the cockpit stamps 'human:ui'; defaults to 'human').
